notes.subject: לחם פנים
notes.rationale: 'mũgate wa ndeo' — bread of faces; translators traditionally 'shewbread/loaves of presence', the faces being Yahwe's own

notes.subject: yakwa
notes.rationale: לפני is a preposition 'to-the-face-of'; the pronoun 'yakwa' (my) supplies whose face, from the 1cs suffix in Hebrew's 'before Me' sense

notes.subject: לפני
notes.rationale: 'mbere yakwa' (before me) vs 'mbere yanyu' — Hebrew preposition lacks explicit suffix here; context (Yahwe speaking) supplies 1st person

translation: Na ũcĩhie meza-inĩ mũgate wa ndeo, mbere yakwa, hĩndĩ ciothe.
